voice.input_audio: Raw 16-bit mono little-endian PCM at 16 kHz; 100 ms chunks [translate-guide]

languages: 70+ languages; the full supported-language and BCP-47 table is in the translation guide [translate-guide]
voice.turn_detection: Continuous translation while the speaker talks; does not wait for conversation turns [translate-guide]
